recognize_zh: 高倍下萎縮的生發中心幾乎沒有中心母細胞，只剩粉紅色玻璃樣物質、樹突狀細胞與內皮細胞；一條小血管從右側穿入中心，外圍小淋巴球呈同心圓排列，構成「棒棒糖」（lollipop）濾泡。
features: Regressed germinal center depleted of centroblasts and centrocytes, with eosinophilic hyaline material
Small penetrating vessel with plump endothelial cells entering the germinal center from the side (lollipop)
Residual follicular dendritic and endothelial cells with vesicular, oval nuclei in the center
Mantle zone of small round lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers around the center
Surrounding interfollicular area with plump endothelial-lined vessels and scattered red cells
describe_en: High-power view of a lymph node follicle shows a small, regressed germinal center depleted of lymphoid cells and replaced by eosinophilic hyaline material, follicular dendritic cells and endothelial cells. A small vessel with plump endothelium penetrates the germinal center from the periphery, producing the lollipop configuration. The mantle zone consists of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers. No atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease-type regressed follicles, as seen in TAFRO-type idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymph node with atrophic follicles (HIV, autoimmune disease, post-chemotherapy)
ddx.vs: Regressed follicles can occur in other settings, so lollipop follicles are not specific and must be integrated with hypervascularity, clinical criteria (TAFRO features) and exclusion of HIV, HHV-8 and autoimmune disease.
Unicentric disease shows similar lollipop follicles, often with more twinning and FDC dysplasia, but presents as a single enlarged node without systemic symptoms.
AITL shows regressed follicles with expanded perivascular FDC meshworks and atypical clear CD10/PD-1-positive T cells in the interfollicular zone, which are not present here.
